notes: Baseline outputs are the same files as iteration 1 (not rerun); only the skill runs are new, built with the revised skill.

The skill dashboard fails two checks here: a 140px horizontal overflow at 375px from a visually hidden data table, and one 32px-high button on phone. The overflow was missed at build time because of a bug in the audit script's phone measurement, since fixed; all runs in both iterations were regraded with the fixed script.

The skill habit tracker fails the tap-target check on day cells that are 37x48px. Seven day cells have to share a 375px row, so this is a deliberate trade-off against the strict 40px rule rather than an oversight.
Pass rate fell from 100% to 89% between iterations while blind reviewers rated the iteration 2 pages the same or better. The measured checks and perceived quality are different things.
Cost: about 2x wall-clock (288s vs 143s) and about 1.65x dollars ($2.17 vs $1.32 mean).
